description:
Return access token details. See the [Authentication Guide](/documentation/oauth-introduction)
for additional information and authentication examples.
The request must contain the access token in the Authorization header: `Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN>`

resource_owner_id.description: ID of the user who authorized the access token. Null for tokens issued with the `client_credentials` grant.

scope.description: OAuth scopes granted to the access token.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

application.description: OAuth application the access token was issued to.

uid.description: Client ID of the OAuth application.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp when the access token was created.
